# Documentation instructions

When working on documentation files:

- Read the file before modifying it.
- Do not delete existing content unless it is clearly obsolete.
- Keep information accurate — read source files before documenting patterns.
- Do not duplicate information across multiple files.
- Keep `docs/ai-context/` files focused on their specific topic.
- Update `docs/ai-context/10-current-priorities.md` when sprint focus changes.
- Create a new ADR in `docs/decisions/` when a significant decision is made.
- Flag sections that need human review with a `> **Needs review:**` blockquote.
- Keep language consistent with the existing documentation style.
- Do not invent technical decisions or architectural facts.
